邪能毁灭会在其持续时间内生成3个灵魂残片。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Vengeance
Fel Devastation damage increased by 25%.

Fel Devastation generates 3 Soul Fragments over its duration.

 Devourer
Void Ray damage increased by 10%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.

 Havoc
Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 虚落流星的伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Voidfall Meteor damage increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
每次未获得无羁邪怒的灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹施放会施加一层沸腾怒意。

沸腾怒意使你获得1%的敏捷，并提高你获得无羁邪怒的几率。持续12秒，且在获得无羁邪怒效果后无法刷新。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Each cast of Soul Cleave and Spirit Bomb that does not grant Untethered Rage instead applies a stack of Seething Anger.

Seething Anger grants 1% Agility and increases your chance to gain Untethered Rage. Lasts 12 sec and cannot be refreshed after gaining Untethered Rage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹可以额外消耗一个灵魂残片，并且每消耗一个残片，就额外造成5%的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Soul Cleave and Spirit Bomb can consume an additional soul fragment and deal an additional 5% damage for each consumed.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹每消耗一个灵魂残片都有几率使你获得无羁邪怒，使你可以施放恶魔变形且不触发冷却时间，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Soul Cleave and Spirit Bomb have a chance per soul fragment consumed to grant Untethered Rage, allowing Metamorphosis to be cast without incurring its cooldown and lasting 10 sec.
